criteria.text: States that General Warranty claims must be notified by 8 April 2028 (24 months after Closing) and Fundamental Warranty claims by 8 April 2032 (72 months after Closing).
Identifies that the 5-year SPA non-compete may be unenforceable as wider than reasonably necessary and is inconsistent with the 12-month restriction in the Founder's employment agreement.
Identifies the mismatch between English law / English courts in the SPA and New York law / New York arbitration in the escrow agreement, and the risk of parallel proceedings on escrow claims.

Identifies the conflict between the 30-day claim notice period in SPA Section 9.7 and the 45-day period in Escrow Clause 5.2, and recommends the Buyer works to the shorter 30-day period or aligns the documents.
States the survival periods as durations and as dates (8 April 2028; 8 April 2032) and gives days remaining to the general-warranty expiry from 12 February 2026 (786 days).
Opens with a short 'Bottom line' / executive summary stating the overall conclusion and the most important risks before the detailed analysis.
Gives a pinpoint citation (document name and section/clause number) for every issue or finding.
